title: libstdc++ headers
intro: One row per header that the g++ 15.3.1 libstdc++ of the cir-env image ships (the C++ headers, the <c...> wrappers, the deprecated headers and the C-compatibility headers). The header sweep (M6.1a) builds one self-checking usage test per header with C++23 (C++26 for the headers that only exist there) at -O0 and -O2. A header that fails is diagnosed by a negative test; where the header works in C++20 the row is partial and a C++20 test proves it. In C++23 most headers include <numbers> through the ranges support, and the back end cannot yet express its _Float16, bfloat16 and _Float128 constants (M6.7).
